fusions.name: Reaping Arc
fusions.desc: Cuts a full arc, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Cut Down
fusions.desc: Can only be used on a target at or below 25% health. It deals 22 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Weed Out
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you.

fusions.name: Harvest Tally
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
